name: INR Tomography with Joint Alignment
aliases: INR Tomography Optimization with Pose Alignment
definition: A fully self-supervised tomographic reconstruction algorithm that uses a neural network as a regularizer to represent the volume as a continuous physical shape function, enabling joint optimization of the 3D volume, missing-wedge inpainting, and per-projection 3D pose (orientation and in-plane translation).
summary: INR Tomography with Joint Alignment is a self-supervised method that jointly optimizes 3D pose and volume density using a continuous neural network, eliminating interpolation and enabling fine sampling for heterogeneous materials.
